title: One Man Refused to Salute Hitler in a Crowd of Thousands
description:
August Landmesser was photographed refusing to give the Nazi salute in a crowd in 1936. He stayed unidentified in the photo for over 40 years.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
